recentItems.title: Why UK troops need to ‘hit back’ against Russia to stop war
recentItems.description:
"Russia is ahead of Nato" – that's the verdict of former CIA Station Chief Sean Wiswesser.

In an interview with BFBS Forces News, he warns that British troops could get caught up in a second front if Putin attacks Nato territory.

As a veteran defence and security professional with a long-standing focus on Russia, Sean Wiswesser speaks with passion and urgency – his assessment is Ukraine has the edge over Russia, but Nato countries lag dangerously behind Moscow.

recentItems.title: I was told never to play again - now I'm Army Rugby head coach
recentItems.description:
The Army men's senior rugby union team have a new head coach, and he's come a long way to get here.

Gerhard Wessels is the first South African head coach for the Army and he has one goal: stop the Navy from winning again.

Find out more about his story, including how he was told his rugby career had to be over after a car crash but returned to playing anyway.

👍 If you enjoyed this video, please like, comment, and share!
